slo_requirements:
Definition & measurement alignment:
- Non-streaming (sync requests, end-to-end client-observed): p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 450ms for typical chat queries (10-40 tokens).
- Streaming (token-by-token): initial-token p50 <= 40ms, initial-token p95 <= 120ms; steady-state per-token p95 <= 30ms for 1-3 token emissions.
- Reranking (batch at server): p95 <= 350ms for 50-200 candidate scoring; throughput target 3000 qps during peak.
- Measurement alignment: agreed canonical measurement is client-side E2E at gateway + server-side token traces; SLA window excludes client network when client cannot demonstrate 95% of users within corporate network via synthetic probes.
- Percentiles interpretation: p50 median, p95 tail for UI responsiveness, p99 used for SLA credits and incident root-cause. Use rolling 1h windows for operational alerts and 30-day windows for SLA compliance.
- Sampling policy: 100% aggregate p50/p95; p99 sampled at 1% token-trace but with targeted full traces for error windows.
throughput_guarantees:
Requested throughput guarantees and measurement: 
- Baseline peak tokens/sec: 120k tokens/sec sustained across reserved pool during market hours.
- Burst policy: 2x short bursts for 10 minutes with autoscale fallback to hosted pool.
- Concurrency: guarantee at least 600 concurrent low-latency chat sessions (avg 5 tok/sec/session) with p95 SLOs maintained.
- Measurement: throughput measured server-side at model ingress, with reconciliation against token billing logs weekly.
reserved_gpu_plan:
Initial sizing proposal:
- Minimum reserved: 8x A100-80GB-equivalent for baseline (sustained market hours).
- Buffer/scale: add 4x GPUs for 30% headroom; 2 additional GPUs dedicated to reranking batch jobs during off-peak.
- Autoscaling policy: scheduled scale-up for market open/close; canary policy for software rollouts.
- Quantization/Model variants: prefer FP16 for latency; if we move to 4-bit quantization validate quality delta in POC.
negotiation_points:
SLA & contract negotiation items: 
- SLA metric definition: server-side vs client-side timing; customer insists on client-observed p95 for UI flows. Redwood proposes server-side p95 + clear client instrumentation guidance.
- SLA credits: propose 3-tier credits (minor, major, critical) tied to rolling 30-day miss rates on p99.
- Blackout windows: planned maintenance excluded; require 48h notice for infra maintenance affecting market hours.
- Fallback behavior: agreed automatic fallback to smaller model variant with documented performance delta; require transparent routing logs.
- Data residency & audit: Private deployment options for audit logs and KMS key ownership are a gating item for procurement signoff.
poC_requirements:
POC success criteria (flat list): 
- Demonstrate sustained p95 below target for 48h under synthetic mixed workload (chat + rerank).
- Token-level traces that map high p99s to specific batching windows or network hops.
- Quantized model quality within 2% NIST BLEU/ROUGE for summarization tests.
- End-to-end observability dashboard with per-route p50/p95/p99 and model-version tagging.
